structure: Texas Administrative Code Ch. 113 Subchapter B (Middle School). One section per grade: §113.18 Grade 6, §113.19 Grade 7, §113.20 Grade 8 ('Adopted 2022'). Each section: heading, (a) Implementation, (b) Introduction with numbered paragraphs (1)-(8) (grade overview, resources, strands, free enterprise, constitutional republic, Celebrate Freedom Week, etc.), (c) Knowledge and skills = numbered TEKS (1)..(n) with strand name (History, Geography, Economics, Government, Citizenship, Culture, Science technology and society, Social studies skills) and 'The student is expected to:' sub-items (A), (B)...; trailing 'Source:' note. Grade comes from the section heading; skills strands repeat in each grade section.
